tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue. Title is required.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue by identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search the workspace by text, identifier, or fuzzy title. Issues by default; pass types to include comment bodies and project names.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues with optional filters.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get a single issue by identifier, including its relations.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on an issue.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Soft-delete a comment by id (uuid). Tombstones it (thread stays intact), not a hard delete. Author only.

tools.name: list_relations
tools.description: List an issue's relations (blocks / blocked_by / related / duplicate).

tools.name: add_relation
tools.description: Relate two issues. type is directional from the source: blocks, blocked_by, related, duplicate_of, duplicated_by.

tools.name: remove_relation
tools.description: Remove a relation between two issues, addressed by target + type.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Permanently delete an issue (sub-issues survive with parent cleared).

tools.name: bulk_update_issues
tools.description: Apply the same field changes to many issues at once.

tools.name: move_issue
tools.description: Move an issue to another team (re-keys its identifier; status remapped, cycle cleared, team-scoped labels dropped).

tools.name: close_issue
tools.description: Close an issue with an optional message.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get the current workspace + reference data (valid team keys, status names, label names, member emails). Call first to learn valid values for issue writes.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: The credential's own notifications (assignments, mentions, comments). Use unreadOnly to poll new ones.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark a notification read (read=false to mark unread, or all=true for every one).

tools.name: get_issue_activity
tools.description: An issue's activity/audit history, oldest first.

tools.name: get_build_rollup
tools.description: The build recorded on an issue, summarised. On a PARENT this is the build with one row per child window (elapsed, gate counts from the last attempt per gate, browse tally, determination) and the latest verify attempt's tree gates; on a CHILD it is the same build sliced to that child's own window. Use this to answer "how did this issue's build go" before reaching for the full record.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: An issue's whole build: every stage attempt with its payload, every child window, every gate row (with the provenance that decides whether a result was observed by the CLI, imported from a file, or asserted by an agent), the sessions that touched it, the report and the derived totals.

tools.name: search_build_events
tools.description: Full-text search over a build's event timeline — the normalized transcript of what the agent actually did, stitched across every session that touched the issue, in timestamp order. Narrow with `child` (one child window), `session` (one session) or `kind`.

child.description: Limit to one child window, e.g. "RAD-383".

kind.description: Limit to one event kind (tool_use, assistant, api_error, …).

tools.name: list_recent_activity
tools.description: Recent status transitions across the workspace in a time window (what moved to In Progress / Done). since = 24h/48h/7d/30d, <n>h/<n>d, or ISO (default 24h). Filter destination with category (e.g. "started,completed") or status names.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List active projects.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a single project by id or name.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project. Name is required.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project by id or name. archived=true archives, false restores.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project by id or name (its issues are kept).

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List the workspace's teams (each key composes its issue ids). includeArchived includes archived teams.

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Create a team (owner/admin). Requires name and key; seeds default workflow statuses.

tools.name: update_team
tools.description: Update or archive a team by id or key (owner/admin). The key is immutable. archived=true archives, false restores.

tools.name: delete_team
tools.description: Delete a team by id or key (owner/admin). Refused if it is the last team or has open issues.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List workspace labels (team-scoped and global).

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label. Omit team for a workspace-global label.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Rename or recolor a label (by id or name).

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a label by id or name.

tools.name: list_cycles
tools.description: List cycles, optionally by team.

tools.name: create_cycle
tools.description: Create a cycle for a team. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: update_cycle
tools.description: Update a cycle by id or number.

tools.name: delete_cycle
tools.description: Delete a cycle by id or number.

tools.name: triage_queue
tools.description: List issues in a triage status.
